selection: 30 carried tasks + 20 purposively selected upstream fixes; no model-outcome-based inclusion.
limits: Public fixes inspected by task constructor; unknown pretraining contamination. Related functions and repositories cross splits. Not a cross-file or SWE-bench benchmark.

cases.description: HelpFormatter.write_usage must emit the usage prefix and program name when args is empty, without a trailing separator space or extra blank line. Preserve custom prefixes and normal nonempty argument rendering. Commands with no parameters and empty or None options_metavar must still show their usage line.

echo must accept empty bytes and bytearray messages with newline enabled on binary output streams, writing a binary newline without TypeError. Preserve nonempty binary output, nl=False, text output, None messages and string conversion of ordinary objects.

style and secho must honor palette index 0 for both foreground and background. Invalid colors must raise ValueError: unknown names, booleans, out-of-range palette indices, and RGB sequences without exactly three non-boolean integer components in 0..255. Preserve named colors, valid palette/RGB colors, reset behavior and plain output when color is disabled.

Serializer and Signer must accept salt=None, using the Signer default salt rather than the Serializer default. Signed values must round-trip, Serializer salt=None signatures must match explicit itsdangerous.Signer salt, and Signer salt=None must match its default. Preserve explicit string and bytes salts, the Serializer default salt, wrong-salt rejection and tamper detection.

TimestampSigner and TimedSerializer must reject a correctly signed timestamp in the future with SignatureExpired when max_age is specified. validate must return False. Preserve acceptance for ages 0 and max_age inclusive, rejection for older timestamps, and existing behavior when max_age is None. Preserve payload and UTC date_signed metadata on expiry, ordinary round-trips and tamper rejection.

TimestampSigner and TimedSerializer must normalize an invalid-signature token with an out-of-range timestamp to BadTimeSignature instead of leaking ValueError or OSError from datetime conversion. Preserve decoded payload metadata and date_signed=None for this malformed timestamp; validate must return False and loads_unsafe must report invalid while recovering a decodable payload. Preserve ordinary timed round-trips, normal invalid-signature timestamp metadata and age expiry. No particular exception message is required.
A custom help flag and another eager option should follow invocation order. Invoking the help flag first must display help without running the later eager callback.
When default_map overrides a dual boolean flag, help output must display the effective default flag rather than the decorator default. Actual invocation and help must agree.
Context-managed resources registered with with_resource must receive the real exception type, value and traceback on exit, and their exception suppression behavior must be respected.

Environment-variable flag values must distinguish activation from deactivation. False-like values must not activate non-boolean flags; true-like values and the exact flag_value activate them. Boolean flag values containing only whitespace represent false. Preserve explicit command-line activation and normal argument conversion.
Empty prompt_suffix must not append a space to prompt or confirm. Preserve normal suffix rendering and input conversion.
Context.invoke must pass None for an omitted optional value, not an internal sentinel. Preserve default type conversion and explicit arguments.
Flags sharing one parameter name must select the configured default regardless of declaration order. Explicit flags must override the default.
interpose must return an empty iterator for an empty input instead of raising StopIteration. Preserve separation of nonempty inputs.
accumulate must return no elements on empty input without an initial value, and retain an explicitly supplied initial value. Preserve cumulative reduction.
join must yield unmatched left rows with right_default for a left outer join, without a NameError. Preserve matched rows and ordinary inner joins.
getter must support an empty list of indexes by returning an empty tuple for any input. Preserve scalar and singleton index behavior.

backoff_iter and backoff must support factor=1 when start equals stop and count is inferred. For unequal endpoints and inferred count raise ValueError rather than arithmetic errors. Preserve explicit-count constant backoff and geometric growth.
split_iter with maxsplit=0 must emit one unsplit list of source values, not a nested source object. Support both lists and iterators. Preserve normal separator splitting.
chunked_iter must chunk Python 3 bytes into bytes segments, including the final short segment. Preserve strings and sequence chunking.
remap must preserve set values under default traversal and preserve frozenset type and values. Do not insert key-value pairs into the reconstructed set. Preserve list and dictionary traversal.

one and only must raise custom exception instances even if they are falsy. A provided too_long exception must avoid evaluating item repr. Preserve default errors, singleton success and empty defaults.
constrained_batches must reject nonpositive max_count with ValueError. Preserve positive count limits, optional count, and maximum-size limits.
seekable.peek and bool must not consume or drop the next input item when maxlen=0. Repeated peek must observe the same next value. Preserve normal cached peeking and exhaustion behavior.
combination_with_replacement_index must match itertools enumeration, including None elements and empty combinations. Reject elements that are not a nondecreasing combination from the pool.
split_before, split_after and split_when must emit no groups for an empty input when maxsplit=0. Preserve one unsplit group for nonempty input and normal predicate splitting.
value_chain must propagate TypeError raised while consuming an iterable, rather than treating the iterable as a scalar. Continue treating objects whose iter() raises TypeError as scalar values.
interleave_evenly must return an empty iterator for no input iterables, including explicitly empty lengths. Preserve balancing of nonempty iterables.
numeric_range.__reversed__ must yield no values for an empty range rather than raising IndexError. Preserve nonempty reverse iteration and normal forward iteration.
numeric_range slicing with a negative step must agree with slicing a materialized range, including omitted and negative endpoints. Preserve positive slicing and integer indexing.
ichunked with zero size must produce no chunks without consuming input; negative size must raise ValueError mentioning n must be at least 0. Preserve positive chunking.
A missing bucket lookup or membership check must not invent keys when iterating bucket keys. Existing bucket contents and valid keys must remain available.
numeric_range with inexact float steps must recognize each item it yields, return its correct index, and report a length matching iteration. Preserve exact integer ranges and nonmember rejection.
chunked must reject negative sizes with a clear ValueError containing n must be at least 0, for empty and nonempty inputs. Preserve positive and None sizes.
numeric_range objects yielding the same singleton must compare equal regardless of step and have equal hashes. Preserve unequal ranges and equality of empty ranges.
sliced must reject negative slice sizes with ValueError under both strict modes, rather than silently yielding incorrect slices. Preserve positive slicing.
windowed must raise ValueError for zero or negative window sizes, including empty sources; preserve positive window padding and step validation.
locate and replace with window_size must never pass internal padding sentinels to user predicates. Tail calls may contain fewer actual items; preserve window matching and replacement.
nth_combination_with_replacement must allow r larger than the pool length. Empty pool with r zero has one empty combination; invalid indexes raise IndexError. Preserve ordinary combinations.
nth_permutation for a requested size greater than the pool length must raise IndexError because no such permutation exists. Negative size remains ValueError; preserve valid indexed permutations.
nth_product and product_index with repeat must handle one-shot iterators like reusable sequences, materializing each input only once. Preserve ordinary product indexing.
gray_product and partial_product with repeat must preserve output when inputs are one-shot iterators. Preserve ordinary traversal with reusable sequences.
Reversing numeric_range must preserve the exact float values yielded by forward iteration, and avoid overflow for datetime boundary ranges. Preserve integer reversal and empty ranges.
zip_broadcast must open a single-use iterable only once, rather than probing iterability then opening it again. Preserve scalar broadcasting and normal zip behavior.
last must propagate TypeError from a user-defined reversed implementation, including when a default is supplied. Preserve default handling for empty iterables and ordinary last items.
xfrange must support descending ranges and produce the same count as frange for inexact ascending steps. Preserve positive integer-step ranges.
backoff must accept start zero, advance to one, and then grow exponentially up to stop. Preserve positive-start backoff and explicit counts.
backoff_iter count repeat must accept a dynamically constructed equal string, without relying on object identity. Preserve finite counts and bounded exponential values.
partition_all must raise LookupError if a sequence reports a length inconsistent with its contents instead of emitting padding or dropping values. Preserve correct lists and iterators.
merge_with must accept a single collections.abc Mapping that is not a dict, treating it as a mapping rather than an iterable of mappings. Preserve merging multiple dictionaries.
